title: Late Fee Review and Reversal — Apartment Home Lease Ledger Card
content:
The late fee review is the basis on which late fee lines post on an Apartment Home Lease and on which late fees posted on any other basis are reversed.

## The review

- A late fee review is made of the most recent late billing period of a lease (the billing period of the latest initial late fee line); earlier periods are not reopened.
- Late fee lines post on the late fee review schedule this rule sets out: the initial late fee on the first late day of the review at the allowed initial late fee, and one daily late fee line at the allowed daily late fee for each allowed daily late fee line, within the period cap.
- The review grace days and the first late day of the review are the effective grace period and the first late day that every other rule of this charter reads.
- The late fee review reversal credits a period whose lines were posted on any other schedule.
- The reversal is posted as one charge reversal credit whose source charge is the period's initial late fee line and whose billing period is that period.

| Late fee lines of the most recent late billing period | Result of the review |
|---|---|
| Posted on the late fee review schedule | the lines stand as posted |
| Posted on any other schedule | a late fee review reversal is credited to the period, against its initial late fee line |

## Posting the reversal: `post_late_fee_review_reversal_dc9bc174`

**Capability.** The tool reverses the part of one billing period's late fees that a late fee review does not allow. One call records a single credit line coded as a charge reversal against the named initial late fee charge, dated today, for the amount given, and lowers the lease's current balance due by that amount. The resident sees the reversal on the lease ledger immediately.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_late_fee_review_reversal_dc9bc174` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lease_id` | The reference number of the apartment home lease whose ledger is credited, read from the lease lookup for the verified resident. | Id |
| `billing_period` | The rent month whose late fees were reviewed — the same month as the initial late fee charge named in `source_charge_id`. | YYYY-MM |
| `source_charge_id` | The reference number of the initial late fee charge line the reversal credit is posted against, read from the lease charge lookup. | Id |
| `amount` | The reversal amount in USD. | Positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with: `status` ("posted" when the reversal credit was recorded); `charge_id` (the reference number of the new credit line); `charge_code` (`charge_reversal`); `billing_period` (the month whose late fees were reviewed, YYYY-MM); `source_charge_id` (the initial late fee charge credited); `amount` (the USD amount reversed, 2 decimal places); `new_balance_due` (the lease balance due in USD after the reversal, 2 decimal places).
